builds.2026-10-15: main at 87009a1d (live web 3f6ce241 for guest captures)
builds.2026-10-16: main at dcd5cde2, the same build as app.getkawase.xyz/version.txt that day (rehearsal before signing, desktop Activity, voice island)

how: Playwright headless Chromium. Phones are 390x797 pt at 3x inside the docs' iPhone frame; desktops are 1440x900 at 2x. Stills are WebP (cwebp q84); clips are H.264 from the Chrome screencast with a WebP poster. Reduced motion, so nothing is caught mid-animation.
money: Every signed-in screen is Arc testnet with test USDC/EURC from Circle's faucet: real testnet transactions, no real money. Mainnet screens are guest views only: quotes and market data, nothing signed.
people: No real person's email, wallet or balance appears. Accounts are @kawase.test test accounts (maya, ines, nia, lena, omar, sam).
